text:
incidents-bot: [PAGER] HIGH - Customer AeroBank (private VPC) reporting increased 502s for inference endpoints via Private NLB. Route: /v1/generate. Impacting ~20% of requests. Page sent to oncall-ryan. severity=high :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: on it, joining. Any alerts/metrics links?

incidents-bot: Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/aerobank/ingress | Logs: https://logs.redwood/aerobank/stream | Recent deploys: none in last 24h

oncall-ryan: I see 502 spike around 02:12 UTC. Errors are TCP reset + target 502s from runtime. Latency OK for successful requests. Starting triage.

netops-anya: Can we confirm NLB healthcheck pass rates and target group statuses? Pasting quick checks:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-aerobank/abcd
```

eng-runtime-lin: Logs show a flurry of "connection reset by peer" from runtime workers around 02:11-02:15. Kernel conntrack counts spiked on their side? Any NAT gateway metrics?

infra-sre-jordan: Customer private VPC uses a managed NAT instance for egress. Their nat-instance CPU went to 95% at 02:10 and conntrack table nearing limit. Could cause partial session drops -> 502s. Pulling metrics.

cust-success-maya: AeroBank reports increased error rates for 2 of their dedicated pools. They're on a maintenance call. They want ETA and mitigation steps.

oncall-ryan: Good find Jordan. Can we temporarily shift traffic off the affected dedicated pools to a warmed fallback pool in the same region? Need quick step-by-step.

netops-anya: We can adjust routing at the Smart Router layer to send traffic to pool-aero-fallback (compatible model variant). Doing a canary shift 10% -> 50% -> 100% unless capacity issues.

eng-runtime-lin: Agree. Before shifting, we should ensure model quantization/profile compatibility. Fallback pool has same model v1.3 quantized. No schema mismatch.

infra-sre-jordan: I'll also open a support link with the customer's cloud account for nat-instance scaling; recommend scaling to a t3.large replacement or enable autoscaling.

oncall-ryan: Proceed with routing change, anya. Notify customer success when in progress.

netops-anya: Starting 10% shift now. Command:
```
redwood-router set-weight --customer AeroBank --from pool-aero-main --to pool-aero-fallback --weight 10
```

incidents-bot: ROUTER_CHANGE event recorded by netops-anya at 02:20 UTC.

oncall-ryan: 10% shifted. Monitoring error rate and upstream health.

eng-runtime-lin: Error rate dropped from 22% -> 12% after 10% shift. Runtime errors still present but reduced. Proceed to 50%.

netops-anya: Increasing to 50%.

incidents-bot: ROUTER_CHANGE event recorded by netops-anya at 02:24 UTC.

oncall-ryan: 50% shift done. Error rate now 5%. Latency stable. AeroBank CS on call confirming partial recovery.

cust-success-maya: Customer says frontend 80% normal, some long-pole requests still failing. They ask if we can fix root cause or keep fallback long-term.

infra-sre-jordan: Root cause: nat-instance conntrack exhaustion causing upstream connection resets to runtime. Short-term: keep routing to fallback pool until customer scales NAT or we provision a managed NAT GW. Recommend they provision NAT gateway or we enable egress path bypass (direct internet egress for runtime) as temporary mitigation.

duty-manager-emma: Escalating to post-incident review. Ryan, Jordan, Anya, Lin - please prepare notes. Maya coordinate SOW/ops options with AeroBank.

oncall-ryan: Will prepare RCA draft. For now keeping 100% on fallback pool to stabilize. netops-anya, flip to 100%?

netops-anya: Flipping to 100% now.

incidents-bot: ROUTER_CHANGE event recorded by netops-anya at 02:32 UTC.

oncall-ryan: 100% shift complete. Customer success confirms 98% recovery. Leaving incident open for remediation tasks and handoff.

cust-success-maya: AeroBank requests a follow-up runbook: options: (1) provision AWS NAT Gateway (recommended), (2) scale/replace NAT instance, (3) request Redwood to provision outbound proxy in their VPC (short-term). Setting meeting for 09:00 their local.

infra-sre-jordan: I'll send suggested CloudFormation snippet to scale nat-instance and conntrack tune suggestions:
```
# sysctl tweak (customer to apply on NAT instance)
net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max = 262144
net.ipv4.netfilter.ip_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established = 1200
```
and note: prefer NAT Gateway for prod.

duty-manager-emma: Thanks all. Handing off to oncall-ryan for follow-up. If anything regresses, page the oncall rotation. Closing this real-time coordination thread. :white_check_mark:

oncall-ryan: Acknowledged. I'll collect logs and write the incident summary. Closing live mitigation channel at 02:45 UTC.
